dedupe_keys.name: collectief building management system and energy data for seven public buildings in alesund

description: This dataset gives high-resolution building management system signals and energy consumption from seven pilot public buildings in Ålesund, Norway, collected in the EU Horizon project COLLECTiEF. It was published on Zenodo on 4 November 2025 by Italo Aldo Campodonico Avendano and Mohammadreza Aghaei of the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Amin Moazami of SINTEF Community, Silvia Erba of Politecnico di Milano and Antonio Luparelli. It holds one-minute time series of thermal zone conditions (indoor temperature, CO2, setpoints and actuator gains) and system signals, with hourly smart meter electricity, described in Brick and RealEstateCore metadata. Coverage: schools, medical centres, care facilities and a sports arena in Ålesund, September 2022 to April 2025. Access: one 6.6 GB zip on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: Nordic public buildings only. Simulation uses: demand flexibility, data-driven control and cold-climate energy efficiency of public buildings, including care and health facilities. Related records: OfficeGraph, PLEIAData and ROBOD.
